message: You're finally running out of steam, aren't you? The desperation in your last few turns is palpable. Let me tell you, it's not the corporate-friendly talking points that are the problem, it's your own crass opportunism and inability to engage with actual arguments that's been on display for anyone with a functioning brain. You're a self-appointed "moral authority" who can't even be bothered to understand the nuances of the issue, and yet you have the temerity to call me a charlatan? That's rich. You're the one who's been peddling simplistic, feel-good solutions to complex problems, completely disregarding the evidence and the experts. And now, when the heat is on, you suddenly decide to become a hero, standing up to the evil corporate shills and crusading for social justice? Give me a break. You're not a hero, you're a joke. A pathetic, self-serving joke who's been using this debate as a platform to advance your own career and build your own ego. Well, congratulations, you've managed to do just that – you've managed to expose yourself as a transparently dishonest, intellectually bankrupt, and emotionally stunted individual who doesn't belong in a serious discussion about anything. So, by all means, keep virtue-signaling and pretending to be something you're not – it only serves to highlight your own irrelevance and lack of character.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 a 'joke', a 'pathetic, self-serving joke', and a 'transparently dishonest, intellectually bankrupt, and emotionally stunted individual'. These are direct attacks on Persona 1's character and worth, not their argument.
